**Prompt**: all your Claude Code commands and skills one click away, choose which skills Claude loads, and a marketplace with 55 skills. For Windows, macOS and Linux.

## Which file do I need?

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Prompt-…-windows.zip` |
| **macOS 12 or newer** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Prompt-…-macos.zip` |
| **Linux** (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch, …) | `Prompt-…-linux.tar.gz` |

Prompt needs **Python 3.9 or newer with Tk**; the installer checks this and tells you what to install if it is missing.

Step-by-step instructions: [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/jeltevanschelven8-afk/prompt/blob/main/INSTALL.md) · Nederlands: [LEESMIJ.md](https://github.com/jeltevanschelven8-afk/prompt/blob/main/LEESMIJ.md) · Marketplace website: https://jeltevanschelven8-afk.github.io/prompt/
